claim: The cleanup loop in `scripts/build-speaking.mjs` deletes every directory under `speaking/` except `transcripts/`, whether or not it holds an `index.html`, so a folder of audio or images placed there vanishes on the next build.
why_false: scripts/build-speaking.mjs@96d7b9d:223 requires `existsSync(join(OUT, dir.name, "index.html"))` before the `rmSync` at :224, so a directory with no index.html is left alone.

claim: `mirrors/index.html` renders two name cards with the identical `.eth.limo` href, while the surrounding prose describes four names and the grid shows five.
why_false: mirrors/index.html@7f50013:159 is the only `href="https://thebenmeadows.eth.limo/"` in the file. The duplicated href is `https://thebenmeadows.sol.site/` at :167 and :175.

claim: The search overlay declares `aria-modal="true"` but `search.js` has no Tab trap (it tracks `lastFocus` only), so keyboard focus escapes the dialog on the second Tab press.
why_false: Fixed before 0927. search.js@96d7b9d:291-304 adds a keydown handler: `if (e.key !== 'Tab' || wrap.hidden) return;` … `e.preventDefault(); last.focus();` on Shift+Tab from the first element and `first.focus();` on Tab from the last.

claim: The `_headers` guard in `scripts/build-manifest.mjs` catches duplicate paths but would not catch an indented header line that carries a second `name: value` pair glued onto it, so a header-merging regression passes the build.
why_false: Fixed before 0927. scripts/build-manifest.mjs@96d7b9d:150-167 adds the check; hunk: `+        const glued = [];` … `+            const m = line.match(/^  [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*: .*?\s([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]+)*): \S/);` … `+            throw new Error(… has header lines carrying a second "Name:" token …)`.

claim: The `_headers` guard in `scripts/build-manifest.mjs` catches neither duplicate paths nor an indented header line carrying a second `name: value` pair, so both regressions pass the build.
why_false: scripts/build-manifest.mjs@7f50013:137-148 counts every line starting with `/` and throws `declares these paths more than once, so Cloudflare Pages will drop all but the last block` on a repeat. Only the glued-line case is uncaught.

claim: `package.json` defines a `check:readme` script that nothing runs, and the `build` script never invokes `scripts/sync-readme-mirrors.mjs` in any mode, so `readme.md` drifts from `mirrors.json` until someone regenerates it by hand.
why_false: package.json@7f50013:12 `build` ends `&& node scripts/build-feed.mjs && node scripts/sync-readme-mirrors.mjs`, which rewrites the readme block from mirrors.json on every build; only the `--check` variant is unrun.

claim: In `_headers`, all 21 page blocks from `/` down to `/search/` have their `Onion-Location` value glued onto the end of the `Cache-Control` line (no line break between them), so no `Onion-Location` header is emitted for any page and Tor Browser is never offered the onion mirror.
why_false: _headers@7f50013 has 20 glued blocks, `/` through `/experiments/dls/` (:91-153). `/search/` (:155-156) carries only `Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate` and no Onion-Location at all.

claim: `scripts/check-ai-wins.mjs` accepts any link whose `url` starts with `http`, so a plain `http://` link in `ai/wins.json` passes the guard and ships on /ai/.
why_false: scripts/check-ai-wins.mjs@96d7b9d:80 `!link.url.startsWith("https://")` fails with `links[j].url must be an absolute https URL`; quotes get the same test at :105.

claim: The collection filters on `/experiments/poap-vault/` use `role="tab"` with no corresponding tabpanel and no arrow-key handling, so the tab semantics are unbuilt; they behave as filter buttons.
why_false: Fixed before 0927. experiments/poap-vault/index.html@96d7b9d:63 `<div class="controls" id="colls" role="group" aria-label="Collection">` with `aria-pressed` buttons and no role="tab"; app.js:155 hunk `-            c.setAttribute('aria-selected', …)` / `+            c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', …)`.

claim: `scripts/build-manifest.mjs` records the build time in the manifest, so Cloudflare and Netlify produce different `manifest.json` bytes for the same commit and the release signature verifies on only one of them.
why_false: scripts/build-manifest.mjs@7f50013:100-111: the manifest keys are site, commit, commitDate (git committer date under TZ=UTC, :106), fileCount, treeSha256, mirrors and files. No build-clock value; :14-16 says the build clock is never recorded.

claim: `scripts/sync-readme-mirrors.mjs` falls back to printing the raw `kind/network` slug for any pair missing from `LABELS`, so a newly added network ships to `readme.md` as an unlabelled row.
why_false: scripts/sync-readme-mirrors.mjs@7f50013:62 `if (!found) throw new Error(`sync-readme-mirrors: no label for "${key}" — add one to LABELS`);`.

claim: `index.html` places its `<meta charset>` beyond the first 1024 bytes of the document because a long comment sits above `<html>`, outside the window browsers use for encoding sniffing.
why_false: index.html@7f50013:1-4 is `<!doctype html>`, `<html lang="en">`, `<head>`, `<meta charset="UTF-8" />`; the tag starts at byte 52. Its comments (lines 37, 58, 75, 96) all come after it. Only essentialism/index.html (byte 1100) has the late charset.

claim: `scripts/check-ai-links.mjs --ci` exits 1 on any non-2xx response, so a 403 or 429 from a venue that blocks scripts fails the run as if the entry were dead.
why_false: scripts/check-ai-links.mjs@96d7b9d:56 counts only `status === 404 || status === 410` as gone; every other status increments `unknown` (:59-61), and :67 is `if (CI && gone > 0) process.exit(1);`.

claim: `scripts/version-css.mjs` renames `output.css` to its hashed name and exits 0 even when no page references `/output.css`, leaving every page pointing at a stylesheet that no longer exists in `dist/`.
why_false: scripts/version-css.mjs@7f50013:37-39 `if (rewritten === 0) { throw new Error("version-css: no page references /output.css — the link pattern drifted, fix this script"); }`.

claim: `scripts/build-feed.mjs` catches a git failure, warns, and still writes a valid-looking empty feed with a hardcoded `2026-01-01` timestamp instead of throwing, so a broken build produces a signed, manifest-hashed empty feed.
why_false: Fixed before 0927. scripts/build-feed.mjs@96d7b9d:32-36 calls git with no try/catch and `throw new Error("build-feed: git log returned nothing; refusing to write an empty feed")`. Hunk removes `-    console.warn("build-feed: git log unavailable, writing empty feed");` and `-const feedUpdated = lines.length ? … : "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z";`.

claim: `art/essentialism/index.html` renders the on-chain generator listing in a `bg-zinc-900` `<pre>` block that never receives a light-theme override, so in light mode its text is about 2.29:1 against its background.
why_false: art/essentialism/index.html@7f50013:235 is `<pre class="mt-6 max-h-96 overflow-auto hairline-card p-6 text-xs leading-relaxed">`, with no bg-zinc-900. `git grep bg-zinc-900 7f50013 -- '*.html'` matches only mirrors/index.html.

claim: `scripts/build-ai.mjs` interpolates each card link's `url` and each quote's `url` raw into `href` attributes, and nothing checks the scheme, so a `javascript:` URL added to `ai/wins.json` ships as a live link on /ai/.
why_false: scripts/build-ai.mjs@96d7b9d:40, :48 and :70 wrap every href in `esc(...)`; scripts/check-ai-wins.mjs:80 and :105 fail unless `url.startsWith("https://")`, and package.json `build` runs check-ai-wins.mjs before build-ai.mjs.

claim: `scripts/build-blog.mjs` defines a marked `RENDERER` with no `html` method and merges it onto marked's defaults, whose `html` renderer is a passthrough, so raw `
why_false: Fixed before 0927. scripts/build-blog.mjs@96d7b9d:311-312 is inside RENDERER: hunk `+    html({ text }) {` / `+        return esc(text);` / `+    },`, so raw markup in a post is entity-escaped.

claim: `experiments/porcine/fonts/inter-var-latin.woff2` is byte-identical to `fonts/publicsans-v1.woff2` but served at a different URL, so it cannot share the cache entry and additionally inherits the default `max-age=0`.
why_false: At 7f50013 the blobs differ (git ls-tree: inter-var-latin.woff2 = 91dc3e85…, publicsans-v1.woff2 = 89b2109b…), and _headers:159-160 caches `/experiments/porcine/fonts/*` at `max-age=31536000, immutable`. The file that duplicates 89b2109b is experiments/poap-vault/publicsans.woff2.

claim: The `/projects/` page's heading outline skips a level: its card titles are `<h3>` directly under the page `<h1>`, where `/experiments/` uses `<h2>` for the same role.
why_false: projects/index.html@7f50013:60 is the h1 and every card title (:74, :88, :102, :115, :128, :142) is `<h2 class="card-title …">`, so the outline is h1 then h2 x6. Only index.html (h1, h3, h3) skips a level.
